papers.title: EFFECT OF Ti6Al4V COLD SPRAYING ON THE SURFACE QUALITY OF ADDITIVELY MANUFACTURED AlSi10Mg ALLOY
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) has emerged as a transformative production technology, enabling the fabrication of complex geometries and customized components, particularly in industries such as aerospace, defense, biomedical, automotive, and energy. The design flexibility offered by AM provides significant advantages, especially in producing intricate structures that are difficult to achieve using conventional manufacturing methods. Among AM-compatible materials, AlSi10Mg alloy stands out due to its high specific strength, excellent thermal and electrical conductivity, and low density. However, the layer-by-layer nature of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) often results in poor surface quality and insufficient mechanical properties. Therefore, post-processing methods are essential to enhance the surface integrity of AM-produced parts. In this study, the cold spraying (CS) process was applied to improve the surface properties of AlSi10Mg samples manufactured by the L-PBF technique. The samples 100x50x5 mm3 in dimensions were fabricated using Aconity MIDI L-PBF machine and characterized using optical microscopy and a non-contact profilometer. Subsequently, Ti6Al4V powders (15–53 µm in diameter) were deposited onto the samples using a cold spray system under the following process parameters: air temperature of 460 °C, air pressure of 7 bar, powder feed rate of 24.9 g/min, and nozzle distance of 5 mm. The spraying process was performed at three different traverse speeds (10, 20, and 30 mm/s) to examine the influence on surface roughness. In the continuation of the study, post-spray surface measurements were taken and compared with the measurements obtained in AM part production.
papers.venue: The International Journal of Materials and Engineering Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti6Al4V冷喷涂对AlSi10Mg表面质量的影响，而非Ti-6Al-4V本身的后处理，与用户方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not concern Ti-6Al-4V as the base material for post-processing; it uses Ti6Al4V only as a coating powder on AlSi10Mg, and it does not evaluate mechanical performance (fatigue/tensile) after post-processing.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the poor surface quality of additively manufactured AlSi10Mg alloy parts.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V powder was cold-sprayed onto L-PBF AlSi10Mg samples at three traverse speeds.
summary_en.result: Cold spraying reduced surface roughness, with the best improvement at lower traverse speeds.
summary_en.validation: Surface roughness and morphology were characterized using optical microscopy and non-contact profilometry.

papers.title: Influence of Tool Clearance Angle and Cutting Conditions on Tool Life When Turning Ti-6Al-4V—Design of Experiments Approach
papers.abstract: The titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V is widely used in the aerospace, medical, and automotive industries; however, its machining remains challenging due to its low thermal conductivity and high chemical reactivity. This study investigates the influence of the tool clearance angle on tool wear during the turning of Ti-6Al-4V under wet cutting conditions. A Design of Experiments (DoE) approach was employed, varying the clearance angle, cutting speed, and feed rate to determine their effects on tool wear. Tool wear was analysed using 3D topography measurements. Regression analysis was used to evaluate the experimental data with the main objective of quantifying the impact of the individual factors and their interactions, resulting in the development of a predictive statistical model. The model’s accuracy was assessed using the coefficient of determination (R2) and the adjusted coefficient of determination (R2adj). The results demonstrate that the clearance angle has a significant impact on crater wear formation and overall tool life. An optimised moderate clearance angle reduces tool degradation, enhances tool life, and improves the surface integrity of the machined component.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-4V的机械加工（车削）过程中的刀具寿命，与增材制造后处理无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address post-processing of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on tool wear during conventional turning, not on improving fatigue/mechanical performance via post-processing.

summary_zh.motivation: Ti-6Al-4V加工困难，研究刀具后角对刀具寿命的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用实验设计方法，改变后角、切削速度和进给率，分析刀具磨损。
summary_zh.result: 后角对月牙洼磨损和刀具寿命有显著影响，优化后角可减少刀具磨损。
summary_zh.validation: 通过3D形貌测量和回归分析验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Machining of Ti-6Al-4V is challenging due to its low thermal conductivity and high chemical reactivity, motivating study of tool clearance angle effects on tool wear.
summary_en.method: A Design of Experiments approach was used varying clearance angle, cutting speed, and feed rate, with tool wear analyzed via 3D topography and regression modeling.
summary_en.result: The clearance angle significantly influences crater wear and tool life; an optimized moderate angle improves tool durability and surface integrity.
summary_en.validation: The predictive statistical model was validated using R² and adjusted R² from experimental data.
